adminRequired.title: Project settings require administrator access
adminRequired.body: Ask a project administrator to update these settings.

notFound.title: Settings page not found
notFound.body: Select a settings section from the navigation.

general.title: Project details
general.description: Update your project's name, description, visibility and avatar.
general.name: Project name
general.privateHint: Only people with access can view a private project.
general.privateForksHint: Changing this also changes the visibility of all forks.
general.privateStarsHint: Making the project private removes all of its stars.

mirror.title: Mirroring repositories
mirror.description: Keep another Git repository updated with this project's changes.
mirror.pushEnabled: Push mirrors synchronize this project to a remote Git repository.
mirror.disabled: Repository mirroring is disabled on this instance.
mirror.pullMirror: This project is a pull mirror.
mirror.passwordHint: Leave blank to keep the current password when the username is unchanged.
mirror.prune: Remove branches deleted from the source
mirror.useSsh: Use an SSH key for authentication
mirror.useSshHint: Forgejo generates a public key to authorize on the remote repository.
mirror.branchFilterHint: Leave empty to mirror all branches.
mirror.archived: Mirrors are not available in archived projects.
mirror.pullBroken: Pull mirror: an error occurred. The mirror settings can't be loaded.
mirror.pullMirrorsDisabled: Push mirrors synchronize this project to a remote Git repository. Your site administrator has disabled new pull mirrors.
mirror.pushMirrorsDisabled: Your site administrator has disabled new push mirrors. Pull mirrors can be created when importing a project.
mirror.pushMirrorsDisabledExisting: Your site administrator has disabled new push mirrors. You can still use your existing mirrors.
mirror.noNewMirrors: New mirrors can't be created at this time. You can still use your existing mirrors.

signing.title: Commit signing
signing.description: Choose whose signatures are trusted in this project.

federation.title: Federation
federation.description: Follow remote repositories through Forgejo federation.
federation.actorIdHint: Copy this URL into the federation settings of another repository to follow this project.

transfer.title: Pending transfer
transfer.description: Waiting for {{recipient}} to accept this project.

maintenance.title: Repository maintenance
maintenance.description: Manage repository health checks and rebuild indexes.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Archive, transfer or permanently remove this project.
advanced.unarchiveDescription: Allow changes to this project again.
advanced.archiveDescription: Make the project read-only while retaining its content.
advanced.transferDescription: Move this project to another user or organization.
advanced.convertDescription: Stop mirroring and turn this into a regular repository.
advanced.detachForkDescription: Remove this project's relationship to its parent repository.
advanced.deleteWikiDescription: Permanently delete every wiki page and its history.
advanced.renameWikiBranchDescription: Rename the wiki's default branch to the instance default.
advanced.deleteDescription: Permanently delete this project, issues, merge requests and files.
advanced.transferPending: This project awaits confirmation of its transfer by {{recipient}}.

units.title: Visibility, project features, permissions
units.description: Choose which Forgejo features are available in this project.
units.contributorsTrackTime: Restrict time tracking to project contributors
units.closeViaAnyBranch: Allow commits on any branch to close issues
units.ignoreWhitespace: Ignore whitespace when checking merge conflicts
units.allowRebaseUpdate: Allow source branch updates by rebase
units.deleteBranchAfterMerge: Delete source branch after merge by default
units.globallyWriteableWiki: Allow anyone with project access to edit the wiki
units.trackerFormatHint: Use {user}, {repo}, and {index} where the tracker requires them.
units.globallyDisabled: Your site administrator has disabled this feature.
units.packagesVisibilityWarning: Packages are visible to everyone who can see {{owner}}, even though this project is private.

members.title: Project members
members.description: Invite individual users and manage their project roles.
members.empty: No individual collaborators. The project owner retains access.
members.teamsDescription: Give organization teams access to this project.
members.removeDescription: The user loses their access to this project.
members.teamsRestricted: Only organization owners can change which teams have access to this project.
members.teamUnitsTip: Team permissions are set in the team settings and can't be changed per project.
members.teamAllTip: This team has access to all projects and can't be removed.

branches.editDescription: Apply a protection rule to a branch name or pattern.
branches.deployKeys: Allow writable deploy keys to push
branches.approvalsWhitelist: Count approvals only from selected reviewers
branches.blockOnRejected: Block merge when changes are requested
branches.blockOnReviewRequests: Block merge while a review request is pending
branches.blockOnOutdated: Require the source branch to be up to date
branches.statusChecksHint: Enter one status check name or pattern per line.
branches.defaultDescription: Choose the branch used for new merge requests and repository browsing.
branches.protectedDescription: Control pushes, merges, approvals and required checks.
branches.archived: Branch settings are not available in archived projects.
branches.recentChecks: Status checks from the last week
branches.recentChecksHint: Select a check to require it by name. Checks that a pattern above matches are marked.
branches.noRecentChecks: No status checks were reported in the last week.

tags.title: Protected tags
tags.description: Prevent tags that match a name or pattern from being changed without permission.
tags.archived: Tag settings are not available in archived projects.

deployKeys.title: Deploy keys
deployKeys.description: Grant external systems access to this repository with an SSH public key.
deployKeys.sshDisabled: SSH is disabled on this instance.
deployKeys.name: Title

values.secretsDescription: Sensitive values are encrypted and made available to workflow jobs. Saved values cannot be read back.
values.variablesDescription: Define reusable values for workflow jobs. Use secrets for passwords and access tokens.
values.keyHint: Use letters, digits and underscores. The key cannot begin with a digit.
values.keepSecretHint: The current value isn't shown. Leave this field empty to keep it, for example when you only rename the secret.
values.secretValueHint: Special characters are kept. Windows line endings are converted to LF; encode the value with Base64 to keep them.

runners.registerDescription: This authentication token is shown once. Save it before leaving this page.
runners.saveConfig: Save this configuration as {{file}} on the machine where Forgejo Runner is installed. The Docker label runs jobs in Node containers.

runners.regenerateHint: The old token will stop working. Register the runner again using its new token.
runners.noJobs: This runner has not processed any jobs here.
runners.removeDescription: Remove this runner's access to the instance.
runners.listDescription: Runners execute CI/CD jobs. Project, namespace and instance runners available in this scope appear below.

runners.tokenDescription: Use this token when registering a runner through the legacy registration flow.
runners.resetBody: New registrations must use the replacement token. Existing runners keep working.
runners.connectionName: Replace the connection name ({{name}} in the example) with a name of your choice.
runners.advancedDocs: To run Forgejo Runner in containers or for advanced configurations, see the <anchor>documentation</anchor>.
runners.labelsNote: Labels are defined in the Forgejo Runner configuration or command-line options and are updated whenever the runner connects to Forgejo.
runners.deleteNotice: A job running on this runner will be stopped and marked as failed.

jobsDescription.project: Recent jobs of this project on this runner.
jobsDescription.organization: Recent jobs on this runner within this organization.
jobsDescription.user: Recent jobs of your projects on this runner.

flags.title: Repository flags
flags.description: Site administrator flags configured for this instance.

webhooks.formDescription: Choose a destination and the events it receives.

storage.noObjects: No large-file objects stored in this project.
storage.lockNotLockable: Path isn't lockable in the default branch
storage.tooLarge: This object is too large to preview. Download it to view its contents.
